pages: Wren Mahon, a girl of fifteen, dark hair in a braid, in a mustard-yellow wool jumper holds one open card folder on her knee, a finger on the writing inside the lid. Middle distance: the long grey telescope tube, a red lamp on the boards. Background: the cold dark southern sky, the Milky Way across it.

Wren Mahon, a girl of fifteen, dark hair in a braid, in a mustard-yellow wool jumper leans to the eyepiece of one long grey telescope, then lowers one red pencil to the observing book on the boards. Middle distance: the card folder, a lens cap. Background: a soft grey patch low in the west, under the Scorpion's sting.

Wren Mahon, a girl of fifteen, dark hair in a braid, in a mustard-yellow wool jumper writes one line in the open observing book with the red pencil, steadying herself on a tripod leg. Middle distance: the finder telescope, the open folder. Background: the Milky Way across the south, the patch gone faint.

Wren Mahon, a girl of fifteen, dark hair in a braid, in a mustard-yellow wool jumper sits on the back step with one open atlas spread on the board across her knees, one protractor held flat in her hand. Middle distance: the observing book, a red lamp. Background: a thin straight tail off a grey patch low in the west.

Wren Mahon, a girl of fifteen, dark hair in a braid, in a mustard-yellow wool jumper holds one protractor up at arm's length, one straightedge arm laid along the thin tail, sighting the reading. Middle distance: the atlas open on the step, the observing book. Background: the grey patch and its straight tail against a dark star field.

Wren Mahon, a girl of fifteen, dark hair in a braid, in a mustard-yellow wool jumper stands in a lit doorway with one closed atlas under her arm, mouth open, one hand flat on the frame. Middle distance: the doorframe lamp, boots on the step. Background: the night field, a low glow in the west.

Wren Mahon, a girl of fifteen, dark hair in a braid, in a mustard-yellow wool jumper sits at the eyepiece of one long grey telescope, writing a fresh position in the open observing book on the boards. Middle distance: the finder telescope, a thermos. Background: the comet four degrees along, faint, setting into the dark ridge.

Wren Mahon, a girl of fifteen, dark hair in a braid, in a mustard-yellow wool jumper bends over the observing book on the kitchen table and writes, the red pencil leaving a short line. Middle distance: the protractor, the closed atlas, a plate. Background: the dark window, the field and the ridge beyond it.

Wren Mahon, a girl of fifteen, dark hair in a braid, in a mustard-yellow wool jumper draws one long smooth arc on a sheet of paper, three marks on it and a curve closed round them. Middle distance: the observation book, a calculator, a straightedge. Background: the garage window, one hanging bulb, night.

Wren Mahon, a girl of fifteen, dark hair in a braid, in a mustard-yellow wool jumper pushes a key on one calculator with her thumb, the garage table bare otherwise. Middle distance: the open observation book, the drawn arc, a mug. Background: the small window, black night, one bulb overhead on its cord.

Wren Mahon, a girl of fifteen, dark hair in a braid, in a mustard-yellow wool jumper writes on the back of one roster sheet spread on the kitchen table, the pencil pressed hard, and stops. Middle distance: the observation book, a calculator, the drawn arc. Background: the window with frost on the glass, a dark shed outside.

Wren Mahon, a girl of fifteen, dark hair in a braid, in a mustard-yellow wool jumper stands in the lit doorway with one hand flat on the door handle, watching out at the concrete. Middle distance: the telescope alone on its tripod, the finder turned aside. Background: the dark hill, low stars, a shed roof.

Wren Mahon, a girl of fifteen, dark hair in a braid, in a mustard-yellow wool jumper leans over the table with one glass photographic plate laid flat under her hand, the atlas open beside it. Middle distance: the observing book, a straightedge, the pencil. Background: the kitchen window, frost, the bulb's warm light.

Wren Mahon, a girl of fifteen, dark hair in a braid, in a mustard-yellow wool jumper writes in one open observing book at the table, the plate held down by her palm, working a line through. Middle distance: the atlas, the red pencil, a ruler. Background: the window, frost, the shed light outside.

Wren Mahon, a girl of fifteen, dark hair in a braid, in a mustard-yellow wool jumper presses the keys of one calculator again and again, the book open beside her hand. Middle distance: the drawn arc, the roster sheet, the mug. Background: the window with the first grey coming up behind the ridge.

Wren Mahon, a girl of fifteen, dark hair in a braid, in a mustard-yellow wool jumper lays one protractor along a drawn line on the sheet and looks where the two arcs cross. Middle distance: the glass plate, the atlas, the observation book. Background: the workshop wall, a hanging bulb, the dark window.

Wren Mahon, a girl of fifteen, dark hair in a braid, in a mustard-yellow wool jumper holds one open observing book up on the table with a finger on two rows of figures, brow down. Middle distance: the calculator, the protractor, the glass plate. Background: the door to the yard, night, one star.

Wren Mahon, a girl of fifteen, dark hair in a braid, in a mustard-yellow wool jumper draws the last line across one open leaf of the observing book, a long arc with three points on it. Middle distance: the pencil, the protractor, the glass plate. Background: the window, the comet faint under the Scorpion's sting.

Wren Mahon, a girl of fifteen, dark hair in a braid, in a mustard-yellow wool jumper rests one fingertip beside a single pencil figure on the front leaf of the open book, and no ring round it. Middle distance: a single upward arrow sketched in pencil, the calculator. Background: the frost-edged window, the field, a slow dawn.

Wren Mahon, a girl of fifteen, dark hair in a braid, in a mustard-yellow wool jumper leans to the eyepiece and writes one more line in the open observing book on the boards, the red lamp beside her. Middle distance: the finder telescope, the cold lens cap. Background: the thin tail pointing out from under the Scorpion, the Milky Way.
